newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong to sell Kingswood Villa flats.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong to sell Kingswood Villa flats.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it will sell 48 units in its Kingswood Villa residential development at an average price of HK$4,089 per square feet.
Registration for potential buyers was scheduled on March 25-28 and the units would be sold through a ballot on March 30, it said in a statement.
The units opened for sale were in the last phase of the company's Kingswood Villa development in Tin Shui Wei in Hong Kong's New Terrorities, it said.
Cheung Kong also said in a separate statement that sales of its joint venture development with China Light and Power Co Ltd, Laguna Verde, was over 51 times oversubscribed.
There were about 4,000 potential buyers registered to buy an initial 78 units following three days of registration on Monday.
Cheung Kong would make an announcement later today on further lifting the number of flats available for sale in Laguna Verde, a company spokesman said.
The company decided on Monday to put 125 units more to the market at an average price of HK$8,787 per square foot, up six percent from the intial price tag of HK$8,286.
